'''Endor''' is the 20th expansion of Star Wars CCG, published by Decipher in June 1999. It is 180 cards (90 Light Side and 90 Dark Side): 80 rares, 50 uncommons, and 50 commons, plus an 18-card foil subset (9 per side). Black border. CardGuide numbering: 20th product (CardGuide lists 198 including foils).

It covers the latter two-thirds of ''Return of the Jedi'' (forest moon). Sold in 9-card packs (MSRP $2.50: 5 commons, 3 uncommons, 1 rare or foil) in 30-pack boxes. A foil replaces the rare in about 1 in 9 packs.<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2]</ref><ref name="wook">[https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Endor_Limited Endor Limited] at Wookieepedia</ref>

== Memorabilia ==
Decipher issued a four-panel poster (~32&Prime; &times; 10.5&Prime;) for every expansion from Premiere through Death Star II. Endor's reverse is the expansion card list.<ref name="encyc" />

[[File:Endor-Limited-four-panel-poster.png|360px|Endor four-panel poster front]]
[[File:Endor-Limited-four-panel-poster-back.png|360px|Endor four-panel poster reverse]]

== Print sheets ==
Rares are 8&times;10 (40 rares twice). Uncommons and commons are 10&times;10 (25 titles four times). Foils are 10&times;10: 2 RF four times, 3 UF nine times, 4 CF sixteen times (except one common per side seventeen times: Ewok Glider Light, Speeder Bike Dark).<ref name="encyc" />
